purpose: Validate Qwen3.5 fine-tuning recipes for both Base and Instruct variants across QLoRA and full SFT on multiple instance types.
hf_naming_finding: On HuggingFace the post-trained ('Instruct') models are published as Qwen/Qwen3.5-{4B,9B} with NO -Instruct suffix. The -Base suffix denotes the pretrained checkpoint. Both share the same Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration architecture; only weights and chat_template differ.
dataset: data/sft-dataset.jsonl (100 synthetic Q/A pairs, system+user+assistant chat format)

tests.purpose: Smoke-test QLoRA pipeline on Instruct variant.
Full-SFT validation of 4B Base on a single 96GB Blackwell GPU.
Confirm Instruct full SFT runs on the same single-GPU footprint as Base.
Full-SFT validation of 9B Base on 4xRTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 384GB total.
Confirm 9B Instruct full SFT on 4xRTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 384GB total.
Validate 9B Instruct QLoRA on the same g5.2xl already validated for 9B Base QLoRA.
Validate 9B Instruct QLoRA on g6e.2xl (1xL40S 48GB) for an alternate single-GPU footprint.
